tagline: OCHOKAT: South Tangerang chocolate/cacao brand identity linked to Pra Suryaning Bela.

story.title: OCHOKAT: South Tangerang chocolate/cacao brand identity linked to Pra Suryaning Bela.
story.body: A government-hosted UMKM record identifies Ir. Pra Suryaning Bela with the brand OCHOKAT in Tangerang Selatan. Public evidence is sufficient to corroborate owner and brand identity, but not detailed chocolate variants, cacao origin or production capacity; those details are therefore left out.
